title: PERF-AEO-500 — Black Performers Registry
description: 500 Black performers (250 actresses, 250 actors) with verified vital data (birth dates on 392 rows, birthplaces on 383, occupations on 410) and a full AEO layer per row. 413 rows are verified against Wikidata/Wikipedia; 87 GAP rows have no Wikidata item and no English Wikipedia article — CultureTechLens is their source of record. Seeded from the founder's Listal lists (S1 217, S2 237, D1-only 33, D2-only 13), which every row credits; this dataset is the named successor to the Listal copy job, closed by the founder's decision on 2026-11-16. 13 rows carry an unresolved MODEL-ONLY SUSPECT flag (§4.4), shipped as-is.
notes: Pre-publication package (v1.0 assembled 2026-11-16 from the canonical 2026-11-05 file). Zenodo deposit pending the founder's token sitting; no DOI yet.
